boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Documented UC Davis study settings centered on Peter J. Shields Library, including silent, collaborative, reservable, computer-based, and after-hours options.

cards.title: Shields Library Courtyard
cards.subtitle: Peter J. Shields Library
cards.notes: Bring work suited to a light-filled courtyard setting, then use the nearby library floors when you need a different study zone.
cards.short_summary: A courtyard study setting in the heart of Shields Library with refreshed landscaping and public art.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Davis Library describes the Shields Library Courtyard as a light-filled place for quiet work or a study break.
cards.source_title: New Spaces, New Faces at Shields Library This Fall
cards.access_notes: Located within Peter J. Shields Library; consult current library hours before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Shields Library East Wing Study Zone
cards.title: Shields Library East Wing Study Zone
cards.subtitle: First floor, Peter J. Shields Library
cards.notes: Head to the far end of the first floor if daylight helps your workflow; the zone has floor-to-ceiling windows on two sides.
cards.short_summary: A first-floor study area expanded after shelves were moved upstairs.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Davis Library documents a light and airy first-floor East Wing study zone with floor-to-ceiling windows on two sides.
cards.source_title: New Spaces, New Faces at Shields Library This Fall
cards.access_notes: Located inside Shields Library; verify current building hours before travel.

cards.title: Shields Library 24-Hour Study Room
cards.subtitle: North side of Shields Library, across from the Quad
cards.notes: Use your student ID at the north-side card reader and plan your work session around the room’s year-round 24-hour access.
cards.short_summary: An after-hours library study room for currently enrolled undergraduate and graduate students.
cards.evidence_claim: Shields Library provides year-round 24-hour study access for currently enrolled undergraduate and graduate students via student-ID entry.
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours year-round for currently enrolled undergraduate and graduate students; swipe a student ID at the north-side entrance.

cards.title: Shields Library IET Computer Room
cards.subtitle: Lower level, Peter J. Shields Library
cards.notes: Choose this lower-level room when a campus computer is useful; check the IET schedule first for current hours and availability.
cards.short_summary: A lower-level computer room within Shields Library.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Davis Library identifies an IET computer room on the lower level of Shields Library and directs visitors to its schedule for availability.
cards.access_notes: Hours and availability are determined by the IET computer-room schedule.

cards.title: Shields Library Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Peter J. Shields Library
cards.notes: Reserve ahead for group work; if a room is unreserved, use the posted QR code to make a drop-in reservation on arrival.
cards.short_summary: Eight reservable rooms for group study, with priority for student groups.
cards.evidence_claim: Shields Library has eight group study rooms available by reservation; unreserved rooms may be used as drop-ins, with priority given to groups.
cards.source_title: Guidelines for Group Study Room Use at Shields Library
cards.access_notes: Reservations have priority; unreserved rooms are first-come, first-served, and groups have priority over individuals.

cards.title: Shields Library Graduate Study Nooks
cards.subtitle: Peter J. Shields Library
cards.notes: Graduate students can request a nook when an assigned personal workspace supports sustained library-based work; availability is limited.
cards.short_summary: Thirty-five assigned study nooks for eligible graduate students.
cards.evidence_claim: Shields Library has 35 graduate study nooks available to PhD and master’s students based on availability.
cards.access_notes: Available to PhD and master’s students based on availability; assignments run for up to one year and require quarterly renewal.

cards.title: Shields Library Silent Study Zones
cards.subtitle: Across floors of Peter J. Shields Library
cards.notes: Use the library floor maps to locate a designated silent area when you need an environment set aside for quiet individual work.
cards.short_summary: Open seating designated by the library as Silent Study.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Davis Library designates open seating areas throughout Shields Library’s floors as Silent Study.
cards.access_notes: Use the Study Spaces section of the Shields Library floor maps to locate designated seating.

cards.title: Shields Library Quiet Conversation Zones
cards.subtitle: Across floors of Peter J. Shields Library
cards.notes: Find a designated Quiet Conversation area through the floor maps when your work includes a Zoom session or low-volume discussion.
cards.short_summary: Open seating specifically designated for quiet conversation and Zoom sessions.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Davis Library designates Quiet Conversation seating areas throughout Shields Library and identifies them as suitable for Zoom sessions.
cards.access_notes: Use the Study Spaces section of the Shields Library floor maps to find the designated areas.

cards.title: Shields Library Collaboration Zones
cards.subtitle: Across floors of Peter J. Shields Library
cards.notes: Use the floor maps to locate a designated collaboration zone, then keep group work within the library’s shared-space expectations.
cards.short_summary: Open seating designated for collaborative group projects.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Davis Library designates open seating areas throughout Shields Library as Collaboration Zones for group projects.
cards.access_notes: Use the Study Spaces section of the Shields Library floor maps to locate designated seating.

cards.entity_name: Academic Assistance and Tutoring Center Drop-in Tutoring
cards.title: Academic Assistance and Tutoring Center Drop-in Tutoring
cards.subtitle: Lower Level, Peter J. Shields Library
cards.notes: Pair independent study with drop-in academic help by checking the tutoring program’s current subjects and drop-in times before you go.
cards.short_summary: A lower-level Shields Library academic-support study setting.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Davis Library states that Academic Assistance and Tutoring Center drop-in tutoring is located on the Lower Level of Shields Library.
cards.access_notes: Check current tutoring subjects and drop-in times before visiting.
